theorem lg_target {X : Type u} {κ : Cardinal.{u}} (hX : HasCardinalLT X κ) [Fact κ.IsRegular] : CategoryTheory.IsCardinalPresentable X κ := by
  let cX := Cardinal.mk X
  have h_cX_lt_κ : cX < κ := hX
  let α := Ordinal.lift (Ordinal.mk ⟨0, 0⟩) (fun x => x)
  let f : X → α := fun x => ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have h_inj : Injective f := by intro x y; cases x; cases y; congr; exact rfl
  let μ := Cardinal.mk α
  have h1 : μ ≤ κ := le_of_exists_injective f α κ
  have h2 : κ ≤ μ :=
    by
      rw [Cardinal.mk_le_iff_exists_injective]
      exact exists_injective f κ μ
  have h_card_α_eq_κ : μ = κ := le_antisymm h1 h2
  exact CategoryTheory.IsCardinalPresentable.mk h_inj h_card_α_eq_κ
